interpretation_rules.evidence_paths: Repository-root-relative. Receipt hashes preserve original local sanitized evidence identity; public assessment does not reproduce raw provider/API responses.
interpretation_rules.source_ordinals: Zero-based source order is preserved, including duplicate dates; ordinal references identify exact compared observations and never imply a first-date join.
interpretation_rules.aliases: Source aliases remain exact; fiscalYear/filingDate take precedence over legacy calendarYear/fillingDate. integer_fiscal_year is schema normalization, not financial arithmetic.
interpretation_rules.origins: Native provider_observation is reported/provider-supplied, not an audited filing assertion. Provider EBITDA, metrics, ratios, market cap, EV, operating_cash_flow and FCF remain provider outputs. Documented alias/type normalization changes no economic definition.
interpretation_rules.metadata_gaps: Null field units/origins remain unknown except where identified evidence corrects an export loss. The three accounting fields reference accounting-metadata-20261106: historical comparisons retain definition/unit/declared basis/origin/availability; scale and reported_currency references are separately proven by pinned annotations. Their exported metadata entries were sanitized away; no provider field repair or receipt reconstruction is required.
interpretation_rules.periods: Metadata annual/discrete_quarter describes declared labels. Actual start/duration, cumulative YTD and restatement conventions remain unverified. Balance measures are instants; cash_at_end_of_period is also instant.
interpretation_rules.numeric_states: Missing, null, zero and negative values are retained by field/source ordinal; signs alone do not validate denominator eligibility. No numeric provider multiple qualifies for a peer aggregate without method approval.
interpretation_rules.calculation_boundary: No house financial result or valuation recommendation is produced; formulas, Python financial recalculation and investment interpretation are outside this REFLECT assessment. Provider outputs are not independently recalculated financial conclusions.

next_slice.proposed_scope: Owner-reviewable IA-B prerequisite contract: retain verified raw/provider inputs, close mandatory provider metadata and financial compatibility gaps, then define the bounded quarterly/peer research App. Implementation requires separate approval.

provider_dependencies.scope: Establish source duration/discrete-versus-YTD/restatement conventions; preserve fiscal labels and statement filing dates without a point-in-time guarantee.

Supply or explicitly contract missing price/EV currencies, share type/date and market/claim dates; preserve the existing accounting annotations through evidence sanitization; expose periodic-only TTM selection in effective-query metadata.
Keep DCF native integration separate; any restoration or new query needs a bounded contract and its own access/widget acceptance. Reuse historical DGS10 only within its original scope.

modeling_dependencies.scope: Approve cash-conversion numerator/denominator, operating cash-flow source, capex sign and lease/accounting adjustment basis; distinguish provider EBITDA/FCF from house adjusted earnings.
Reconcile fiscal calendars, reporting/trading currencies, market dates, basic/diluted weighted averages versus dated EV shares, debt/cash and all enterprise-to-equity claims.
Define and validate peer membership, trailing/forward windows, positive/zero/negative/missing denominator eligibility and aggregation; no numeric provider multiple is automatically eligible.
IA-C separately owns DCF formulas, assumptions, units, valuation date, terminal conventions, cost of capital and sensitivity validation.

presentation_gaps.scope: Design period-aware tables/charts, explicit data-origin and missingness labels, financial metadata access, editable peer rationale/assumptions and saved research context.
A raw/provider-data App may be an independently approved interim scope; it cannot claim IA-B analytical completion.
